narration: In 2026, new studies added to a decade of hints that Mercury may not be fully dead.
visual_brief: Colourful cutaway (MESSENGER color mosaic); real NASA/ESA imagery, never presented as another mission.

candidates.title: Spectacular Color . . . with Better Yet to Come
candidates.description: This spectacular color mosaic shows the eastern limb of Mercury as seen by NASA MESSENGER as the spacecraft departed the planet following the mission first Mercury flyby in January 2008.
